cross_product_finding: This page is the CBL-side syntax reference for the same surface grammar as server/'s SQL++ (SELECT/FROM/WHERE/JOIN/GROUP BY/ORDER BY/LIMIT/OFFSET), and the doc explicitly states the format 'is based on that of Couchbase Server's SQL++ query language'. However, per the batch instructions we checked query-n1ql-mobile-server-diffs.md specifically, and it documents enough real divergence (no NEST, no UNION/INTERSECT/EXCEPT, only LEFT OUTER JOIN, scalar-only comparisons, SQLite-based ordering and boolean logic, query-only - no CRUD, no CREATE INDEX) that we minted a CBL-specific umbrella concept rather than reusing a server/ statement-level concept id verbatim. We do not have visibility into whether server/'s batch minted concept ids for SELECT/JOIN/UNNEST etc. (the given registry only lists privilege/edition/version/index-state concepts), so a coordinator will need to decide whether/how to link cbl:sql-plus-plus-mobile's sub-features to server/'s equivalents.
